incident: A Supabase/control-plane-only merge activated the website delivery lane because an unscoped .github/workflows path was treated as shared executable work. Production readback then waited for an exact Netlify deployment that was unrelated to the change.
root_cause: createDeliveryPlan intentionally fans generic shared executable paths out to all lanes. Delivery-control-plane workflows and classifier code were not given a narrower backend scope, so website applicability was over-classified.
prevention_rule: Canonical delivery-control-plane workflows, contracts and classifier code are backend-only scoped paths. Generic future workflows remain shared and fail-safe; only explicitly listed control-plane authorities receive the narrow scope.
outcome_goal: Supabase-only terminal delivery closes on Supabase production-ledger proof without requiring an unrelated Netlify exact-SHA deployment.
